description: This Java source file defines the CreateSubscription class, which is a command object for subscribing to search results within the Ditto framework. It includes fields for filter, options, fields, namespaces, and prefix, along with methods for construction, payload creation, and JSON serialization/deserialization. It extends an abstract command and implements querying capabilities.
